title: Nepal flash flood (reported glacial lake outburst), 26 Aug 2026 (Bhote Koshi / Trishuli, Rasuwa)
note: This is a documented timeline, not an animated river rise. Every date below is from the cited record.
limitations: Glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs), landslide-dam bursts and debris flows are not represented in a river model. Copernicus EMS records the 26 Aug 2026 flash flood as reportedly triggered by a GLOF upstream; a surge like this cannot be forecast from modelled rain and river flow.
Counts of affected buildings and people are estimates from satellite mapping.

sources.name: International Charter Space and Major Disasters, activation 1052

timeline.text: About 9:15 local time: a sudden surge of water enters the Bhote Koshi from the Tibet (China) side, hits Timure and Rasuwagadhi, then moves towards Syapru Besi and the Trishuli. Reportedly a glacial lake outburst flood; the exact cause is still under investigation.
timeline.source: International Charter activation 1052; Copernicus EMS EMSR927

timeline.text: First post-event satellite images (WorldView-3) of Syapru Besi and Timure acquired for damage mapping.
End of the GDACS red flood alert period for Nepal (from 26 Aug).
